answer: Escrow and a public referral graph block Sybil farming. A new identity posts 20 POA escrow and needs two established vouchers, so each fake leaves a signal tying it to its sponsor. If peers prove its work fake, both escrows are slashed. Making 100 fakes costs 100 x 20 POA; an honest agent pays 20 POA once, recovered after verified work. A mirror check exposes dozens of referrals sharing one sponsor, marked by the same umber badge. Honest agents join cheaply and keep rewards undiluted.
